classification.resume: The document is a video recording of a theatrical performance titled "Stauffer-Bern" by Herbert Meier, featuring excerpts from the play, a book by Bernhard von Arx, and a portrait of Karl Stauffer-Bern. It was filmed at the Studio Wolfbach of the Zurich Schauspielhaus and broadcast as part of the "Panorama der Woche" series in December 1974.
